title: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
author: Lewis Carroll
summary: A bored girl follows a waistcoated white rabbit down a hole and lands in a world where logic, size and manners keep changing. She meets a string of odd creatures and tries to make sense of their rules.
readIf: you enjoy nonsense, wordplay and dream logic, or want the source of countless later references.
skipIf: you need a coherent plot or a character arc; this is a string of surreal scenes.

pairings.reason: Another classic where a girl is swept away to a strange land and meets odd companions, but with a clearer quest.
A girl finds a door to a stranger, darker version of home, written with the same sense of unsettling wonder.
Short and whimsical too, but gentler and more focused on feeling than on silliness.
